label: Japan will not flip to China
description: Given 10 September 2025 while praying stability over Japan as a strategic ally: he reports hearing that they will not flip with China and go over there. A rare negative prediction, which can fail.
aliases: They will not flip with China
Japan to stay as an ally

label: A mega minister shot, the shot heard around the world
description: Given 10 September 2025, the day of the Kirk killing: he says he was told to pray for that minister, that he saw who it was, a mega minister, and that he heard a shot around the world. He does not name him, which is a fifth withholding on file.

label: An extension from Japan to South Korea against a North Korea to China line
description: An extension seen running from Japan to South Korea, and a similar but less severe line running from North Korea into China like a highway. Four named states in two pairs, which is checkable.
aliases: extension from Japan to South Korea
